name: Deep Learning Backbone Substitution
description: Replaces the feature_engineering + model_training pair with a pretrained backbone + finetune pattern. This is a rewrite, not an expansion — the feature engineering is absorbed into the pretrained backbone's learned representations.

with_nodes.name: load_pretrained
with_nodes.description: Load a pretrained backbone (ImageNet, BERT, etc.) and optionally freeze early layers

with_nodes.name: finetune
with_nodes.description: Finetune the backbone on competition training data with appropriate learning rate schedule, augmentation, and regularization

with_nodes.name: test_time_augmentation
with_nodes.description: Optional: apply augmentations at test time and average predictions for robustness

notes: After rewrite, the pipeline looks like: load_data → load_pretrained → finetune → [TTA] → prediction_ensemble → output. This is the dominant pattern for image and NLP competitions.
